name: corrections
description: Turns a recurring correction into an enforced check. /corrections:codify counts how often a described mistake recurs, picks the strongest enforcement-ladder rung that can catch it, and proposes a check proven to fail on the old code and pass on the current code, using scripts/prove-check.sh to run it in temporary worktrees at two refs. It also takes a review findings file (codify findings <file>) or merged pull requests' review comments (codify reviews) as the source.

ratchet_offer.title: Ratchet offers
ratchet_offer.description: When on (default), a /corrections:codify proposal on a rung that counts violations offers /toolchain:ratchet for a non-zero count once the rule exists. Off leaves the offer out. A repository's <home>/corrections.yaml wins over this option.

review_mining_prs.title: Review mining window (merged PRs)
review_mining_prs.description: How many recent merged pull requests /corrections:codify reviews reads for review comments; default 20, from 2 to 200. A repository's <home>/corrections.yaml wins over this option.

findings_buffer_adapter_repository.title: Findings-buffer adapter repository
findings_buffer_adapter_repository.description: Git common directory (git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) of the one repository whose own findings-buffer adapter you trust. Applies in that repository's checkout and worktrees only. Unset: only adapters the plugin ships run.

findings_buffer_adapter_path.title: Findings-buffer adapter path
findings_buffer_adapter_path.description: That repository's adapter directory, relative to the checkout root, holding executable append.sh and read.sh and a capabilities.json with schema_version 1.x. Set both options or neither. A path out of the checkout or into a nested repository is refused.
